ruleset.name: search-ranking-class-complexity
ruleset.description: Class-wide complexity check, exempting Facades, Factories, Bridges, EntityManagers and Mappers for the same reason phpmd-public-methods.xml does: ExcessiveClassComplexity sums each method's own cyclomatic complexity across the whole class (WMC), so it scales with method COUNT as much as with real branching. Every one of these layers is, by Spryker's own architecture, one thin delegating method per business capability/collaborator/entity-transfer pair -- each method individually trivial (CC=1), but the sum climbs with the module's surface area regardless. A high score here reflects the module having many capabilities, not any one method being hard to follow; the per-method rules in phpmd.xml (CyclomaticComplexity, NPathComplexity, etc.) still apply in full to these same files, so a genuinely complex method on a Facade/Factory is still caught. Run as its own phpmd invocation, separate from phpmd.xml — see that file's description for why.
